Workflow:

1. Get cell fractions of malignant cells 
2. Add all metadata from Seurat objects in 
3. Basic analysis 
  - Association with risk, MRD value, etc. 
  - Differences in cell type frequency by subtype, if present 
4. Survival differences between low and high (top 25%)

# Functions
```{r}
separate_malignant_ctype <- function(cbs.mtx){
  mal.cbs.mtx <- cbs.mtx %>% dplyr::select(-starts_with("Healthy"))
  
  mal.cbs.mtx <- mal.cbs.mtx %>% group_by(Mixture) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(prop.sum = sum(c_across(starts_with("Blast"))))
  
  blast.cols <- colnames(mal.cbs.mtx)[grepl("Blast", colnames(mal.cbs.mtx))]
  
  for(i in blast.cols){
    mal.cbs.mtx[,i] <- mal.cbs.mtx[,i]/mal.cbs.mtx[,"prop.sum"]
  }
  
  return(mal.cbs.mtx)
}
```

# Load Seurat object 
## Edit metadata 
```{r}
cog.s <- readRDS("BALL_StJudesCohort_SeuratObject_RLogValues_111125.rds")

cols.to.modify <- c("Treatment.Arm", "WBC.count.at.baseline","Time.to.Relapse.early.intermediate.late.", "CNS.status.at.baseline", "Bone.Marrow.status.at.baseline", "First.event.type", "Day.8.Percent.MRD", "Day.29.MRD.category")

cog.s@meta.data <- cog.s@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(all_of(cols.to.modify), ~str_split_fixed(., ":", 2)[, 2]))
cog.s@meta.data <- cog.s@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(EFS.indicator = if_else(If.had.a.relapse=="0:No", 0, 1))

cog.s$Day.29.Percent.MRD <- as.numeric(cog.s$Day.29.Percent.MRD)
cog.s$OS.years.from.Dx <- as.numeric(cog.s$OS.years.from.Dx)
cog.s$Age.at.Relapse <- as.numeric(cog.s$Age.at.Relapse)
cog.s$EFS.years.from.Dx <- as.numeric(cog.s$EFS.years.from.Dx)

cog.s$time.EFS <- cog.s$EFS.years.from.Dx * 365
cog.s$time.OS <- cog.s$OS.years.from.Dx * 365
cog.s$status.OS <- as.numeric(cog.s$OS.indictor.from.Dx)

cog.s@meta.data <- dplyr::mutate(cog.s@meta.data, Day.29.MRD.category = 
                  case_when(Day.29.Percent.MRD < 0.01 ~ "<0.01%",
                            Day.29.Percent.MRD >=0.01 & Day.29.Percent.MRD <0.1 ~ "0.01-0.1%",
                            Day.29.Percent.MRD >=0.1 & Day.29.Percent.MRD <1 ~ "0.1-1%",
                            Day.29.Percent.MRD >=1 & Day.29.Percent.MRD <5 ~ "1-5%",
                            Day.29.Percent.MRD > 5 ~ ">5%",
                            ))

cog.s@meta.data <- dplyr::mutate(cog.s@meta.data, Day.29.MRD.Positivity = 
                  case_when(Day.29.Percent.MRD < 0.01 ~ "Negative",
                            Day.29.Percent.MRD >=0.01 ~ "Positive",
                            ))
```

# Ctype data load 
```{r}
cog.d <- read.delim("StJudes_COG_Fraction0.25_SplitEL_MylComb_ComBatRef_CIBERSORTx_Adjusted.txt")
cog.d.mal <- separate_malignant_ctype(cog.d)

cog.s@meta.data <- left_join(cog.s@meta.data, cog.d.mal, by=c("COG_USI"="Mixture"))
```

# Overall Deconvolution Plots 
```{r}
# Not batch corrected matrix 
cog.d.list <- cog.d.mal %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols=(starts_with("Blast")), names_to = "Ctype", values_to = "Fraction")

cog.d.list <- left_join(cog.d.list, cog.s@meta.data, by=c("Mixture"="COG_USI"))

cog.d.list$Ctype <- factor(cog.d.list$Ctype, 
                           levels=c("Blast_HSPC","Blast_CLP","Blast_Pre.pro.B","Blast_Pro.B",
                                    "Blast_Pre.B","Blast_Immature.Mature.B","Blast_Myeloid"))

pdf("ProjCtypeDecon_CellFractionFrequency.pdf", width=5, height=5)
ggboxplot(cog.d.list, x="Ctype", y="Fraction",outlier.shape = NA, fill = "Ctype",ncol=1) +
  rotate_x_text(angle=45) +
  geom_jitter(size=0.05)
dev.off()

```

```{r}
ctype.fractions <- colnames(cog.d.mal)[grepl("Blast*", colnames(cog.d.mal))]

plot.list <- list()
p.km.list <- c()
p.ch.list <- c()

pdf("COG_SurvivalPlots_MalignantCtypeFractions_010126.pdf", height=5, width=10)

for(j in 1:length(ctype.fractions)){
  
  score.name <- ctype.fractions[j]
  
  if(score.name %in% c("Blast_CLP", "Blast_HSPC", "Blast_Pre.pro.B") ){
    next
  }
  
  survival.data = cog.s@meta.data
  
  survival.data$mpp.rank =  survival.data[[score.name]] %>% rank()
  
  #hist(survival.data$Blast_HSPC)
  
  survival.data = survival.data %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(high.mpp = case_when(mpp.rank > (nrow(survival.data)*0.75) ~ "Sig High",
                                       mpp.rank < (nrow(survival.data)*0.25) ~ "Sig Low"))
  
  survival.data <- survival.data %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(high.mpp))
  
  
  table(survival.data$high.mpp)
  os_km_fit <- survfit(Surv(time.EFS, EFS.indicator) ~ high.mpp , data=survival.data)
  #cox.test = coxph(Surv(time.EFS, EFS.indicator) ~ high.mpp + EOI.MRD, data=survival.data)
  cox.test = coxph(Surv(time.EFS, EFS.indicator) ~ high.mpp, data=survival.data)
  cox.coefs.gene.and.mrd = summary(cox.test)
  
  if(nrow(survival.data) >100 ){
    p.val = cox.coefs.gene.and.mrd$logtest[3] %>% print()
  }else{
    p.val = cox.coefs.gene.and.mrd$sctest[3] %>% print()
    
  }
  
  # if("CNS" %in% colnames(survival.data)){
  cox.test2 = coxph(Surv(time.EFS, EFS.indicator) ~ survival.data[[score.name]] +  CNS.status.at.baseline + WBC.count.at.baseline,
                    data=survival.data)
  # cox.test2 = coxph(Surv(time.EFS, EFS.indicator) ~ mpp.rank + cns.status,
  #                    data=survival.data)
  cox.test.summary = summary(cox.test2)
  p.val.signature = cox.test.summary$coefficients[1,5] %>% print()
  
  # }else{
  #   cox.test2 = coxph(Surv(time.EFS, EFS.indicator) ~ survival.data[[score.name]], data=survival.data)
  #   # cox.test2 = coxph(Surv(time.EFS, EFS.indicator) ~ mpp.rank + EOI.MRD, data=survival.data)
  #   cox.test.summary = summary(cox.test2)
  #   p.val.signature = cox.test.summary$coefficients[1,5] %>% print()
  #   
  # }
  
  p.km.list <- append(p.km.list, p.val)
  p.ch.list <- append(p.ch.list, p.val.signature)
  
  p.os = autoplot(os_km_fit)+ ylim(c(0, 1.0)) + 
    labs(x = "EFS (Days) ", y = "Survival Probability", 
         title = "") + 
    theme_classic()+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), 
          # axis.title.x = element_text( colour="black", size = 25),
          # axis.title.y = element_text( colour="black", size = 25),
          # axis.text = element_text(size = 20),
          legend.title = element_text(face="bold"))+
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#BE433D","#459DA5"))+
    scale_color_manual(values =  c("#BE433D","#459DA5"))
  
  p.os + scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "white"))
  
  
  survival.data.boxplot = survival.data %>% filter(EFS.indicator %in% c("Alive", "Dead", 1, 0))
  survival.data.boxplot = survival.data.boxplot %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(EFS.indicator.plot = case_when(EFS.indicator == 0 ~ "No Event",
                                              EFS.indicator == 1 ~ "Event"))
  
  p.save = p.os + scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "white")) + 
    geom_step(aes(color = group), alpha = 0.8) + 
    geom_point( shape = "+") +
    scale_color_manual(values =  c("#BE433D","#459DA5")) +
    annotate(geom = "text", label = paste0("p =", round(p.val, 5)), x=1000, y=0.4) +
    annotate(geom = "text", label = paste0("p.sig =", round(p.val.signature, 5)),x=1000, y=0.50) +
    ggtitle(label = paste(score.name), subtitle = paste("n=", nrow(survival.data.boxplot)))
  
  p.save.2 = ggplot(survival.data.boxplot, aes(x = EFS.indicator.plot, y = survival.data.boxplot[[score.name]])) + 
    geom_point(position = "jitter") +
    geom_violin(draw_quantiles = c(0.5), alpha = 0.5) + 
    stat_compare_means() +
    theme_bw() +
    ggtitle(score.name, subtitle = paste( "n=", nrow(survival.data.boxplot))) +
    labs(y = score.name)
  
    print(cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = list(p.save, p.save.2)))
  
}

# dev.off()

```

# Survival differences by subtype 
```{r}
ctype.fractions <- colnames(cog.d.mal)[grepl("Blast*", colnames(cog.d.mal))]

plot.list <- list()
p.km.list <- c()
p.ch.list <- c()

subtype.list <- unique(cog.s$Primary.sample.subtype)

pdf("COG_SurvivalPlots_Subtype_MalignantCtypeFractions.pdf", height=5, width=10)

for(i in 1:length(subtype.list)){
  
  score.name <- "Blast_Myeloid"
  
  current.subtype <- subtype.list[i]
  
  # if(current.subtype %in% c("NUTM1", "Low hypodiploid") ){
  #   next
  # }
  
  survival.data = cog.s@meta.data %>% dplyr::filter(Primary.sample.subtype==current.subtype)
  
  survival.data$mpp.rank =  survival.data[[score.name]] %>% rank()
  
  #hist(survival.data$Blast_HSPC)
  
  survival.data = survival.data %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(high.mpp = case_when(mpp.rank > (nrow(survival.data)*0.5) ~ "Sig High",
                                       mpp.rank < (nrow(survival.data)*0.5) ~ "Sig Low"))
  
  survival.data <- survival.data %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(high.mpp))
  
  table(survival.data$high.mpp)
  os_km_fit <- survfit(Surv(time.EFS, EFS.indicator) ~ high.mpp , data=survival.data)
  #cox.test = coxph(Surv(time.EFS, EFS.indicator) ~ high.mpp + EOI.MRD, data=survival.data)
  
  res <- try({
    # code that might error
    cox.test = coxph(Surv(time.EFS, EFS.indicator) ~ high.mpp, data=survival.data)
  }, silent = TRUE)
  
  if (inherits(res, "try-error")) {
    # skip this iteration
    next
  }
  
  cox.coefs.gene.and.mrd = summary(cox.test)
  
  if(nrow(survival.data) >100 ){
    p.val = cox.coefs.gene.and.mrd$logtest[3] %>% print()
  }else{
    p.val = cox.coefs.gene.and.mrd$sctest[3] %>% print()
    
  }
  
  res <- try({
    # code that might error
    cox.test2 = coxph(Surv(time.EFS, EFS.indicator) ~ survival.data[[score.name]] +  CNS.status.at.baseline + WBC.count.at.baseline,
                    data=survival.data)
  }, silent = TRUE)

  if (inherits(res, "try-error")) {
    # skip this iteration
    next
  }
  
  
  # if("CNS" %in% colnames(survival.data)){
  
  # cox.test2 = coxph(Surv(time.EFS, EFS.indicator) ~ mpp.rank + cns.status,
  #                    data=survival.data)
  cox.test.summary = summary(cox.test2)
  p.val.signature = cox.test.summary$coefficients[1,5] %>% print()
  
  # }else{
  #   cox.test2 = coxph(Surv(time.EFS, EFS.indicator) ~ survival.data[[score.name]], data=survival.data)
  #   # cox.test2 = coxph(Surv(time.EFS, EFS.indicator) ~ mpp.rank + EOI.MRD, data=survival.data)
  #   cox.test.summary = summary(cox.test2)
  #   p.val.signature = cox.test.summary$coefficients[1,5] %>% print()
  #   
  # }
  
  p.km.list <- append(p.km.list, p.val)
  p.ch.list <- append(p.ch.list, p.val.signature)
  
  p.os = autoplot(os_km_fit)+ ylim(c(0, 1.0)) + 
    labs(x = "EFS (Days) ", y = "Survival Probability", 
         title = "") + 
    theme_classic()+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), 
          # axis.title.x = element_text( colour="black", size = 25),
          # axis.title.y = element_text( colour="black", size = 25),
          # axis.text = element_text(size = 20),
          legend.title = element_text(face="bold"))+
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#BE433D","#459DA5"))+
    scale_color_manual(values =  c("#BE433D","#459DA5"))
  
  p.os + scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "white"))
  
  
  survival.data.boxplot = survival.data %>% filter(EFS.indicator %in% c("Alive", "Dead", 1, 0))
  survival.data.boxplot = survival.data.boxplot %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(EFS.indicator.plot = case_when(EFS.indicator == 0 ~ "No Event",
                                              EFS.indicator == 1 ~ "Event"))
  
  p.save = p.os + scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "white")) + 
    geom_step(aes(color = group), alpha = 0.8) + 
    geom_point( shape = "+") +
    scale_color_manual(values =  c("#BE433D","#459DA5")) +
    annotate(geom = "text", label = paste0("p =", round(p.val, 5)), x=1000, y=0.4) +
    annotate(geom = "text", label = paste0("p.sig =", round(p.val.signature, 5)),x=1000, y=0.50) +
    ggtitle(label = paste(current.subtype), subtitle = paste("n=", nrow(survival.data.boxplot)))
  
  p.save.2 = ggplot(survival.data.boxplot, aes(x = EFS.indicator.plot, y = survival.data.boxplot[[score.name]])) + 
    geom_point(position = "jitter") +
    geom_violin(draw_quantiles = c(0.5), alpha = 0.5) + 
    stat_compare_means() +
    theme_bw() +
    ggtitle(score.name, subtitle = paste( "n=", nrow(survival.data.boxplot))) +
    labs(y = score.name)
  
    print(cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = list(p.save, p.save.2)))
  
}

dev.off()
```

```{r}

pdf("COG_CellTypeAssociationsWithMetadata.pdf", height=6, width=10)

p1 <- cog.s@meta.data %>%
  group_by(Primary.sample.subtype) %>%
  mutate(median_myl = mean(Blast_Myeloid)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=reorder(Primary.sample.subtype, -median_myl), y=Blast_Myeloid, fill=Primary.sample.subtype)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size=0, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(size=0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1),

  ggplot(aes(x=reorder(Primary.sample.subtype, -Blast_HSPC), y=Blast_HSPC, fill=Primary.sample.subtype)) +
```
